# Nexteck — Software Development Company London | Web, Custom Software & AI Strategy

> Nexteck (https://www.thenexteck.com) is a premier Software Development Company in London, UK, founded by Principal Consultant & Software Architect Mohammed Nasar (25+ years of enterprise IT & software experience across Banking, Insurance, Manufacturing, Education, and E-commerce). We deliver bespoke web & custom software solutions, end-to-end business process audits, workflow automation, and costed 90-day IT & AI roadmaps for UK SMEs.

## Core Services & Solutions
- **Custom Software Development London**: Bespoke web applications, internal business portals, custom booking/member engines, and SaaS platforms when off-the-shelf software falls short.
- **Web Development & System Integration**: High-converting web platforms, CRM/ERP unification, API integrations (Zapier, Make, custom REST APIs), and real-time BI dashboards.
- **SME Business & AI Strategy Audits**: Rigorous 4-stage engagement covering Client Diagnostic, Industry Benchmarking, Competitor Analysis, AI/IT Opportunity Scoring, SOP Delegation, and KPI Governance.
- **Engineering Sourcing & Industrial Procurement**: Strategic OEM spare parts sourcing, capital equipment, and low-cost country bridging across 9 mission-critical sectors.

## Targeted Industrial Sectors
1. **Oil, Gas & Petrochemicals**: Spare parts & OEM supply and sourcing for upstream, midstream and downstream operators (API 6D valves, turbomachinery, seal kits, ATEX sensors).
2. **Mining & Drilling**: Rotating equipment, heavy gearboxes, slurry pumps, and tungsten carbide drilling consumables for demanding site conditions.
3. **Industrial & Process Plants**: Tailored materials, bespoke CNC machining, pressure vessels, and castings sourced to client technical drawings and physical samples.
4. **Railways**: Rolling stock (bogie sets, axles, dampers, brakes) and rail infrastructure components sourced in strategic partnership with pearlconrail.co.uk.
5. **Water & Waste Water**: High-efficiency pumps, valves, fine bubble aeration, filtration membranes, and SCADA telemetry for municipal and industrial plants.
6. **Chemicals & Lubricants**: Vetted vendor relationships across specialty greases, synthetic compressor oils, REACH-compliant solvents, and bulk chemical supply.
7. **Manufacturing Plants**: Consumables, carbide cutting tooling, PLC automation components, and capital equipment for continuous automated production lines.
8. **Lab & Medical Equipment**: Clinical analytical instrumentation, diagnostic sterile consumables, and controlled sourcing under ISO 13485 standards for the UK medical device supply chain.
9. **Low Cost Country supply and sourcing**: Bridging vetted Tier-1 manufacturing capacity across India (Pune, Chennai, Gujarat) and the Asia-Pacific region into UK & global supply with 30%-55% cost reductions and strict UK QA audits.
